name: Reditus
detailed_description:
Game Overview:

In the aftermath of the god Corydon Deus’s mysterious disappearance, the world of Reditus has been plunged into a spiritual and magical void. Religion and magic are now outlawed by the technologically dominant state of Reditus, which has exiled the faithful to the desolate wastelands of Heremus.

You play as Augustus, a devout believer, and his son Caeser, a skeptic dreaming of a better life with his betrothed, Theresa. Together, they journey through the unforgiving Heremus in search of the lost city of Vehere, seeking to reclaim lost magic and challenge a world that has abandoned the divine. Along the way, they confront both ideological enemies and monstrous threats, testing their bond, beliefs, and purpose.

Core Mechanics:

  • Exploration & Quests
    Traverse a semi-open world packed with lore-rich NPCs, branching side quests, and narrative-driven objectives. Dialogue choices and actions influence party dynamics, story outcomes, and philosophical alignment—faith, doubt, or something in between.

  • Strategic Turn-Based Combat
    Combat is dynamic, emphasizing enemy weakness exploitation. Breaking enemy guards through the AMP (Assault Momentum Protocol) system allows for powerful follow-up strikes.

  • Quick Time Events (QTEs)
    Add precision-based depth to combat—parry enemy blows, land critical hits, or activate timed combat bonuses during pivotal moments.

  • Overdrives
    As damage is taken, characters charge unique Overdrive attacks—devastating moves that can dramatically shift the momentum of battle, ideal for boss encounters.

  • Character Progression
    Gain experience, craft and loot equipment, and unlock abilities shaped by personal growth and philosophical leanings.

Other Notable Features:

  • No Random Encounters – Enemies roam the environment, allowing players to strategize before engaging.

  • Fast-Paced Turn-Based Battles – Streamlined without losing tactical depth.

  • Loot, Steal, and Craft – A deep item system rewards exploration and clever use of resources.

  • 16-bit SNES-style Sprites & 3D Models – A nostalgic yet modern visual hybrid.

  • PSX-Inspired Soundtrack – Music that echoes the golden era of RPGs.

  • 60–70 Hours of Gameplay – A sprawling, content-rich experience.

  • Mini-Games Galore – A variety of fun distractions woven throughout the main game.

  • Multi-Party Tactical Battles – Manage simultaneous teams in large-scale strategic combat.

  • Robot Recruitment & Arena Battles
    Negotiate with sentient machines in SMT V-style conversations to recruit them to your cause. Each robot comes with unique abilities and personalities. Use them in a dedicated Battle Arena, where they fight in fast-paced, tactical showdowns—collect, train, and master them all.

short_description: Reditus is a richly crafted 2.5D JRPG that fuses retro-inspired pixel art with modern 3D environments. Set in a mystical world where magic has vanished, the game follows a father-son duo on a dangerous pilgrimage to restore lost divine power.
